settings.windowHelp: Where the main window appears when the app opens. The size is always restored from last time.
settings.rulesHelp: When an agent in a background tab stops to ask you something, the screen is recognized by these rules and you are notified. The rules file can add, replace or disable built-in rules.
settings.controlHelp: Lets agents inside terminals use highostty ctl to read other tabs, run in the background, and more. Read-only: view only. Full: can also open tabs and send input. Only newly opened tabs get the related environment variables.
settings.skillHelp: The skill teaches an agent how to use these commands. Nothing is written until you press a button: it goes into each agent's skills folder (skills/highostty/SKILL.md under ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.copilot, ~/.gemini) and can be removed at any time. For other agents, copy the content into their global instructions.
settings.sc.childTab: Another tab in the same folder (child tab)
settings.skill.outdated: Installed; a newer version is available (press Update)
settings.skill.foreign: A file with the same name not installed by HiGhostty exists; it will not be overwritten
settings.skill.copied: Skill content copied to the clipboard
